overlayEntry.notes: Reviewed 2026-07-27 as an ERC-4626 staking wrapper whose ultimate portfolio is the separately measured cUSD reserve and operator-lending system; this replaces the 2026-07-20 entry with refreshed measurements and a newly-evidenced legalEnforceability component. At finalized Ethereum block 25627260 (hash 0xe4256d655597cf47800fdcc665ddb4d92f4daf19572401088d7f5591dc51c161, 2026-07-27T22:53:11Z), asset() on stcUSD 0x88887be419578051ff9f4eb6c858a951921d8888 returned cUSD 0xcccc62962d17b8914c62d74ffb843d73b2a3cccc; totalSupply was 62,255,932.853420 shares, totalAssets was 66,778,886.926195 cUSD, and convertToAssets(1e18) matched totalAssets/totalSupply exactly, a 1.072651 cUSD-per-share rate. The cap.app reserves dashboard (captured 2026-07-27T23:02Z) reports cUSD in circulation $73.08M against reserves $73.09M, basket assets USDC $67.98M and WTGXX $5.10M, reserve deployment of 62.18% operator borrow debt, 29.98% Steakhouse Prime V2 (Morpho v2), 6.99% WTGXX, 0.86% Gauntlet USDC (Morpho v2) and dust in Aave USDC/idle USDC, underwriter capital $224.15M against borrows $45.52M. weightedAverageMaturityDays 3.000821 refreshes the prior 3.023155 with the same methodology: the WTGXX basket share (5.10/73.08 = 6.9787%, corroborated by the dashboard's 6.99% deployment slice) multiplied by the fund's SEC-filed 43-day average portfolio maturity, with the remaining ~93.02% (demand USDC lending deployments and operator borrow debt) treated as zero-day; maturity transformation inside the operator-loan book remains unestablished, as before. valuationCadenceDays 0 is unchanged: continuous oracle-valued accounting. The pinned WisdomTree N-MFP3 for 2026-06-30 (filed 2026-07-06, accession 0001193125-26-296145) was re-verified on EDGAR on 2026-07-27 as still the freshest filing; it reports 43-day average portfolio maturity, 48-day average life, and 100% daily liquid assets. Component changes: legalEnforceability is now graded weak (previously omitted) because a primary legal document evidences the deficiency itself: the Cap Platform Terms of Use (Covered Agents S.A., Panama, last revised 2025-03-26) impose a full user release of all claims against the company (6.3), state the user's sole remedy is to cease using the platform (11), disclaim any third-party beneficiary rights (13.7), and route disputes to individual Panama arbitration; no enforceable stcUSD holder claim on a reserve estate or bankruptcy-remote issuer is established anywhere in the documentation. This matches the apxusd-apyx calibration where the issuer's own terms document the absence of a legal claim. creditQuality, valuationCadence, maturityAndLiquidity, and custody remain adequate on the regulated-asset whitelist, SEC-filed fund data, atomic proportional-basket redemption, measured on-chain custody, and exact wrapper reconciliation. seniority and recovery remain limited: the dashboard now publishes current underwriting collateral ($224.15M underwriter capital vs $45.52M borrows), and the financial-guarantees documentation describes per-loan escrowed underwriter collateral with automated liquidation plus an offchain underwriter-borrower recourse agreement, but that offchain agreement is between underwriter and borrower — it confers no documented claim to cUSD/stcUSD holders — and the dashboard figures carry no independent attestation or dated reconciliation, so the adequate evidence class is not met. NOT established: stcUSD holder priority relative to unstaked cUSD, the Insurance Fund balance, realized liquidation performance, or maturity transformation from deployed fractional-reserve strategies.
